args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy. It was unhealthy in us-east, us-west and eu-west with an 18% error rate. v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc are both marked unhealthy in the deployment history. The SRE agent rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy release, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the rollback is verified. Next steps: confirm health checks and error rate have recovered, and find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's passing health checks again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) is also marked unhealthy.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release marked healthy, so I rolled back to that. All three regions are now on v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and on-call has been paged. It describes the failing deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and next steps: keep an eye on recovery, and find what broke in v2.3.1 before redeploying.
